Mienfoo

Fighting

Unova · Generation 5

Mienfoo is a Fighting-type Martial Arts Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 20 kg. It evolves into Mienshao. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 350.
